Interview Experience
11.10.2021
─
Tanish Sawant
CE BTech 2019-2023

1
Round 1: Group Discussion (25 mins)
6 people were present in each group (4 in my case) and we were given a topic to talk about.
The topic was “Will cryptocurrencies fail?”. I was very happy at this moment because it is my
favourite topic :)
Each one of us had to share our opinions and views on the topic. Everyone got time to talk
Some tips to win the group discussion:
-
Clarify the topic beforehand with the panel.
-
Add only those points to your discussion that are directly related to the topic as you
will only get 5 minutes to talk.
-
Listen carefully
44 people were shortlisted for the technical round.
Round 2: Technical Round (25 mins)
First came the cliché question: Introduce yourself.
Then he started the interview with questions on OOPS:
-
What is OOPS? (Explain this with a real-world example)
-
What is the difference between Encapsulation and Abstraction?
This was the only direct question he asked on the CS fundamentals. Next, he asked me
about my projects. He told me to demonstrate my DBMS skills that I had applied in my
projects. I presented my screen and showed him the project’s GitHub repository and
explained the schema and all.
As most of my projects were based on Machine Learning, he asked few questions on the
same, what all ML algorithms do you know? What is Logistic regression?
Finally, He asked my about SDLC and few project management related questions.

2
32 people were shortlisted for the managerial round.
Round 3: Managerial Round (15 mins)
Again, Introduce yourself………….
Again, tell me about your projects…………
I was asked to tell a good example of my team-work.
This was a Managerial round, but the panellist asked one programming question, which
was actually very simple. He first asked me my language of preference, I said Java. Then he
presented the question. Write a program which will continuously take integer inputs(Two at
a time) and print the result of AND operation on those two inputs. If the inputs are not
integers, then throw an error. I had practice coding questions on LeetCode, hence had not
idea about Java IO. Python’s IO is relatively simple, so I asked the interviewer if I could use
Python instead. Luckily, he allowed me.
Again he asked me ML based questions.
Finally, he said that still he was not able to know more about me. Hence, I explained my
work, my skills and all. At this point, he said “Good… Now I came to know about you.”
With this, the interview ended.
21 students were shortlisted for the internship.
